purpose: Study forecast freshness and consensus construction using forecast accuracy only, before any stock-return outcome or stale-cutoff optimization.
sourceDependency: Requires an authorized canonical PIT analyst-estimate source satisfying analyst_forecast_revision_pit_contract_v0_1.
primaryUnit: symbol × target fiscal period × forecast basis × asOf

actualAlignment.rule: Compare forecasts only to the first decision-time eligible actual EPS for the same target fiscal period and compatible EPS basis.
actualAlignment.corrections: Later restatements are separate vintages; do not rewrite the original forecast-accuracy target unless the experiment explicitly studies corrected actuals.

forecastAge.policyRule: Bands are diagnostics only. No stale cutoff or production weight may be chosen from stock-return outcomes.
forecastAge.horizonRule: Age comparisons are within identical target fiscal horizon/basis.

preregisteredConsensusVariants.description: Mean of each forecaster's latest active same-horizon compatible forecast as of decision time.
Median of each forecaster's latest active same-horizon compatible forecast.
Single most recent compatible forecast; benchmark only, not assumed best.
Mean of the three most recent compatible forecasts when coverage>=3; benchmark motivated by recency/aggregation literature.
Mean of compatible forecasts published in the prior 30 calendar days; literature benchmark only, never a preselected production cutoff.

guardedSecondary: absolutePercentageError only when actualEPS is positive and safely away from zero
scaledAbsoluteError using an ex-ante frozen positive scale
prohibited: treating negative/near-zero actual EPS percentage errors as ordinary comparable errors
choosing a metric after seeing stock returns

hypotheses: FRESH_H1: More recent forecasts may be more accurate, but recency benefit must be measured after holding target horizon/basis constant.
FRESH_H2: A synchronized multi-forecast consensus may outperform an unsynchronized all-active mean because stale forecasts dilute information.
FRESH_H3: The most recent single forecast need not dominate a recent multi-forecast consensus because recency and aggregation trade off.
FRESH_H4: Any apparent analyst-ability ranking must be robust to timing advantage, sparse coverage and heterogeneous firm predictability.
FRESH_H5: Forecast-age effects may vary with company size, disclosure intensity and event proximity; no universal stale cutoff is assumed.
falsification: If age loses explanatory power after event timing/horizon/coverage controls, reject universal freshness weighting.
If a 30-day composite is not consistently more accurate than other preregistered variants, do not promote 30 days as a cutoff.
If sparse coverage or a few firms dominate relative-accuracy rankings, classify ANALYST_RANKING_FRAGILE.
If provider membership/history cannot be reconstructed point-in-time, accuracy comparison remains SOURCE_BLOCKED.
